$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor on 2026-07-28 and independently derives from deploy/phala/docker-compose.yml; image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v10 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30340900982). The proof-v10 change is copy-only: the honest-disclosure text on /proof still described the pre-ingress topology (TLS terminating at a Phala gateway in front of the enclave), which stopped being true when dstack-ingress moved TLS termination inside the confidential VM; it now states that, and no longer implies the attestation says anything about what the code records for usage and billing. Frontend-only, but the image is measured, so both images were rebuilt and composeHash moved with them (c0136825… → c86ba435…). The enclave's E2EE public key is derived from the app key and is unchanged across this upgrade.
